topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Oh my gosh, can you even believe it? My partner’s been writing a novel about me, and I just found out! It’s like, wow, right? I mean, sure, I’ve always known they have a vivid imagination, but this—this is something else entirely. The way they captured all those little moments, the ones we thought were just passing by, it’s incredible. I’m walking on air, thinking about how much they must care to pour all that time and heart into something so personal. It’s not just a story; it’s our story. I can’t wait to sit down and read it all, see how our bits and pieces fit into this big, beautiful narrative.
